target_zone_range.evidence_basis: Hays — Natural Purola flora lists O. laciniata. Travis — UT Plant Resources Center Onagraceae herbarium index includes O. laciniata. Williamson — dedicated county treatment documents O. laciniata.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Exact county evidence only; historical Gaura/Calylophus names are counted only after synonym reconciliation.

morphology.look_here_first: Start with the cut or lobed leaves and nocturnal yellow flowers. Cutleaf evening primrose is a low annual or short-lived perennial with alternate leaves that range from toothed to deeply cut-lobed, and 4-petaled yellow flowers that open around sunset.
diagnostic_traits: annual or short-lived perennial from taproot
leaves variable from dentate to distinctly cut-lobed

comparisons.key_distinctions: Unlike O. capillifolia, the leaves are much broader and commonly cut-lobed. Unlike the gaura-like species, flowers are radially symmetric and yellow rather than white/pink and strongly zygomorphic.
